$comment: This file does not exist in the repository as inherited, while the root package.json
declares src/api as an npm workspace. npm tolerates that silently: the workspace is
never installed and nothing reports it. Verified on npm 10.8.2, which completes an
install against a declared but absent workspace without warning.
Dependencies are declared here rather than at the root because this is the manifest
that owns the files importing them. @aws-sdk/client-dynamodb and @aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb
are the two undeclared imports in config/ and scripts/seed.ts. aws-sdk v2 is retained
for now because src/api/models still imports it and removing it is a rewrite, not a
manifest edit; it is end of support and npm prints its deprecation on every install,
which is a reason to schedule the rewrite rather than to pretend the import is gone.
ioredis is retained on the same terms and is expected to be deleted outright when
Redis is removed, which is separate M3 work.
Remove this $comment key before committing. It is here so the reviewer of the pull
request does not have to reconstruct the reasoning.
